body: R3-01 and R3-02 are fixed: TS-RESPONSIVE-029, no-tests.md TC-003 and testcases.md TC-003 now apply the `doc/todo/` rule only to existing files (`--diff-filter=DMRT`). The FR-RESPONSIVE-030 summary in no-use-cases.md still says that `doc/todo/` is unchanged, but the branch adds `doc/todo/issue-200-r1-02.md`. This is the same scoping slip in a summary file, and no check depends on it. Suggested fix: say 'the existing files under `doc/todo/` are unchanged', to match TS-RESPONSIVE-029 and TC-003. Not blocking.
